# hacdias/webdav: repairing a WebDAV server without a test suite

This is a server that publishes folders from disk over the network so that clients can read, write, move and lock what is in them, and it has stopped behaving. Nothing about the protocol changed and nothing about the clients changed, yet things that were served correctly are now served wrongly, several operations that used to be refused now go through, and several that used to go through are now refused. The repository has received 24 separate undocumented edits. What follows is everything that has been noticed from the outside, in the order it was run into.

Signing in is where it first shows. An account whose password is written out literally in the settings file is now refused with 401 when the right password is sent, and let in when a wrong one is sent; an account whose password is kept as a hash logs in exactly as it always did. An account whose login name is given as an environment reference never loads at all: with the variable exported and holding a value, loading still stops with a complaint that the name's environment variable is empty, and the name never comes out as what the variable holds.

Deciding what a signed-in account may touch then goes wrong in several separate ways.
